clinic_info.name: Apex Dental Center
clinic_info.location: 100 Feet Road, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru (Near Sony World Signal)
clinic_info.legal_disclaimer: Notice: AI Triage provides preliminary pricing ranges and scheduling guidance. Final treatment plans require an in-person clinical examination by a licensed dentist.

procedures.name: General Dental Consultation & Checkup
procedures.description: Comprehensive intraoral evaluation by senior dentists with digital X-ray and personalized treatment roadmap.

procedures.name: Dental Implants
procedures.warranty: Lifetime Warranty on Swiss Straumann / Nobel Biocare Implants
procedures.description: Permanent titanium tooth root replacement with computer-guided placement. Includes 3D CBCT imaging and custom zirconia crown.

procedures.name: Invisalign Clear Aligners
procedures.warranty: 5-Year Guarantee with free tray refinements & Vivera retainers
procedures.description: US-FDA approved transparent removable aligners for discreet teeth straightening without metal wires.

procedures.name: Traditional Metal & Ceramic Braces
procedures.description: High-precision metal and tooth-colored ceramic bracket braces for comprehensive teeth alignment.

procedures.name: Teeth Cleaning & Ultrasonic Scaling
procedures.description: Ultrasonic painless removal of plaque, tartar stain, and gum calculus, followed by high-gloss enamel polishing.

procedures.name: Tooth Filling & Cavity Restoration
procedures.description: Tooth-colored German composite resin restoration to fix decay holes, gaps, and tooth wear seamlessly.

procedures.name: Tooth Extraction & Wisdom Tooth Surgery
procedures.price_range_inr: ₹2,500 - ₹8,500 (depending on simple vs painless surgical wisdom tooth removal)
procedures.warranty: Includes complimentary post-op checkup & sutures removal
procedures.description: Painless extraction of damaged or impacted wisdom teeth under computer-assisted local anesthesia.

procedures.name: Single-Visit Root Canal Treatment
procedures.warranty: 10-Year Structural Integrity Guarantee (when paired with Zirconia Crown)
procedures.description: Pain-free rotary endodontic treatment completed under magnification to eliminate deep dental infection.

procedures.name: Professional Laser Teeth Whitening
procedures.description: In-office 45-minute laser teeth whitening that brightens teeth up to 8 shades instantly without enamel sensitivity.

procedures.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
procedures.description: Complete restoration of severely worn, missing, or broken teeth using All-on-4 / All-on-6 computer-guided implant bridges.

faqs.question: Where is Apex Dental Center located?
faqs.answer: We are located at 100 Feet Road, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru, right near the Sony World Signal. We have free dedicated valet parking for all patients!

faqs.question: What are your clinic operating hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM for prior appointments and emergency consultations.

faqs.question: How much is the initial consultation fee?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive initial consultation fee is ₹500, which includes a complete digital intraoral exam and treatment planning session with our senior specialist.

faqs.question: Do you accept health insurance for dental treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes! We support cashless treatment & reimbursement assistance for major health insurers including Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, and corporate TPA policies for surgical procedures & extractions.

faqs.question: What flexible payment and EMI options do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer 0% interest monthly EMI plans over 3, 6, 12, or 18 months for treatments above ₹15,000 via Bajaj Finserv, Credit Cards, and LiquiLoans.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide free dedicated basement parking and complimentary valet parking for all our patients at our 100 Feet Road Koramangala facility.

faqs.question: Are treatments painful?
faqs.answer: All surgical and root canal procedures are performed under painless computer-controlled local anesthesia or conscious sedation, ensuring 100% comfort during treatment.
